$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopResultShare realizes LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.8's SharedResult concept and is the terminal artifact of LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md §3's share-flow state machine (entered at RECEIPT_STORED). Read that document FIRST, specifically for: (1) the FB-RAT-RES-004 correction — the verification label is SELF_SIGNED_RECEIPT, NOT the source draft's unsupportable RUNTIME_ATTESTED (§6: 'the only claim a verifier MAY draw... is: the same key signed these N receipts... never that a genuine Fonebrew binary, a specific device, or an unmodified runtime produced any of them'); and (2) the coarse-bucketing requirement (§4: duration, retry totals, per-node counts, and token/cost aggregates MUST be reported as one of a small number of coarse, versioned ranges, never raw values — a high-dimensional quasi-identifier otherwise, per the cited USENIX Security 2024 token-length side-channel work). This schema encodes that requirement STRUCTURALLY: durationBucket/aggregateCostBucket/aggregateTokensBucket (plus retryCountBucket, added per the same requirement) are each a closed enum-of-named-ranges, not a `type: number` field with a documentation-only promise to bucket it before populating — a producer CANNOT construct a schema-valid document carrying a raw numeric duration/cost/token value here even if it tried. FIELD-LIST NOTE: this work package's task brief's literal field enumeration for this document (packageDigest, engineVersion, terminalState, nodeStateSummary, durationBucket, aggregateCostBucket, aggregateTokensBucket, localCloudRatio, capabilityCategories, verificationClaim) is EXPANDED here in two grounded, non-silent ways: (a) 'packageDigest' becomes the full `releaseIdentity` {loopId, semanticVersion, packageContentDigest} tuple, because LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md §4's own allowlist row groups these three as one unit ('loop ID, release version, and package digest') — a digest alone, without the family/version it belongs to, does not satisfy that row; (b) `terminalReasonCategory`, `retryCountBucket`, and `bucketingVersion` are added because §4's own text requires them ('terminal state AND terminal reason category'; 'duration AND retry totals... MUST be bucketed'; a versioned bucketing scheme 'following the same pattern as semanticDigestVersion and rulesetVersion'). Two things §4's fuller allowlist names are DELIBERATELY OMITTED, not silently dropped: execution-target categories (localCloudRatio here already carries the coarse local/remote/CI split §8 defines) and verifier outcomes / user ratings (FB-RAT-RES-005's four-label correctnessEvidence scheme and the worked-for-me rating are a materially larger, separately-shaped addition this document's assigned field list does not ask for — forward-pointed to a future schema revision, not modeled here).
title: LoopResultShare
description: The final, redacted, bucketed, previewed, consented, optionally-signed artifact a user's explicit Share Result action produces and that MAY leave the phone (LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md §1-§7). Built only from a LoopRunSummary (loop-run-summary.schema.json), itself built only from a completed or terminal LoopRun (loop-run.schema.json) — never constructed directly from live run state. DEFAULT-EXCLUDED FIELDS (FB-RAT-RES-003) MUST NOT appear anywhere in this schema, not even as an optional property: prompt and model response content; repository, branch, file, symbol, project, and organization names; source code and diffs; file contents or paths; raw logs and terminal output; credentials, aliases, tokens, keys, and hostnames; IP/MAC/device-serial/USB identity; generated artifacts; user identity unless explicitly attached; private comments and human decisions. Their absence IS the contract — this schema sets `additionalProperties: false` throughout (a deliberate, explicit deviation from this corpus's usual `additionalProperties: true` + `unknownFields`-bag convention) specifically so no producer, however well-intentioned, can construct a schema-valid document carrying any of them.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this shared-artifact shape. Not the same axis as `ContractEnvelope.schemaVersion` when this document is carried as `ContractEnvelope<LoopResultShare>` payload — this is the payload's own version (§4: 'result schema version... is ContractEnvelope.schemaVersion... which only the outer envelope carries' notwithstanding, this field is retained here so the document validates standalone per this corpus's convention).

shareId.description: Stable ID for this share instance — the 'exact share digest' §7's consent receipt records a pointer to (FB-RAT-COM-002).

releaseIdentity.description: loopId, semanticVersion, packageContentDigest (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §2, §4) — this document's expansion of the task brief's literal 'packageDigest' field, per §4's own grouped allowlist row. Exact values, never bucketed — exact identity is the whole point (compatibility evaluation, dedup, aggregate cohort grouping, §4).

engineVersion.description: capability-ids.v1.json's engineVersion (§4). The Fonebrew APP version is deliberately NOT a field here — it lives on `ContractEnvelope.producer.version` when this document is carried as that envelope's payload (§4), not duplicated inside the payload.

terminalState.description: One of loop-run.schema.json RunState's 8 terminal values (§4). Never a free-text reason and never one of RunState's 9 non-terminal values — sharing is only ever triggered from a completed or terminal run (FB-RAT-RES-001).

terminalReasonCategory.description: §4: 'terminal state and terminal reason category... MUST itself be one of a small closed set of coarse categories, never a free-text reason.' Same closed vocabulary as loop-run.schema.json/loop-run-summary.schema.json's TerminalReasonCategory — but note NO `detail` free-text field is carried here (contrast loop-run-summary.schema.json's TerminalReason object, which does carry `detail`): the category alone survives into the shared artifact.

nodeStateSummary.description: §4: node-state counts and stable public node IDs 'where permitted' (gated on publishedLoop, same rule as loop-run-summary.schema.json), with per-node counts now BUCKETED (this document's stage, per the coarse-bucketing requirement).

bucketingVersion.description: §4: versions the bucket-boundary scheme durationBucket/retryCountBucket/aggregateCostBucket/aggregateTokensBucket/nodeStateSummary's per-outcome counts all use, 'following the same pattern as semanticDigestVersion and rulesetVersion elsewhere in this constellation.' This document fixes that a version MUST be carried; the exact boundaries a given bucketingVersion encodes are documented alongside the enum values below, not a separate registry (no bucket-boundary registry exists in schemas/loops/registries/ as of this freeze — this schema IS that fixing point).

localCloudRatio.description: §8: coarse local/remote/CI fractions computed from ExecutionTargetType categories, never host identity. `computed=false` ('no ratio computed') for a zero-eligible-work run — never a default-to-zero percentage.

capabilityCategories.description: The coarse 8-value capability-ids.v1.json `category` enum only — never a specific reverse-DNS capability ID (§4).

verificationClaim.description: §6, FB-RAT-RES-004 (corrected). Required and non-null here (contrast loop-run-summary.schema.json, where it is nullable pending signing) — §3's RECEIPT_SIGNED transition MUST produce either a signed SELF_SIGNED_RECEIPT claim or an explicit UNSIGNED marker, 'never silently omitted.'

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this share artifact was finalized, i.e. §3's RECEIPT_STORED transition (FB-RAT-COM-004).

NodeCountBucket.description: Coarse per-node/per-outcome count range (§4 coarse-bucketing requirement, 'per-node counts').

DurationBucket.description: §4 coarse-bucketing requirement, 'duration.' Boundaries fixed by this schema's own bucketingVersion (see that field's description) — this is a schema-authoring choice, not a re-derivation of a pre-existing registry (none exists for bucket boundaries as of this freeze).

VerificationClaimLabel.description: RES-004 correction (§6): renamed from the source draft's unsupportable RUNTIME_ATTESTED — no implementable signing-key option in this pack's own analysis supports a genuine runtime-attestation claim (see §6's three-option analysis). SELF_SIGNED_RECEIPT proves only pseudonymous key continuity across shares; UNSIGNED is the explicit no-key marker §3 requires rather than silent omission.

claimText.description: Fixed to the exact honest wording per label — see this $def's allOf for the two const strings. A consumer MUST NOT present either as evidence of runtime authenticity, app integrity, or correctness of any kind (§6).

signingKeyFingerprint.description: Android Keystore-held, non-exportable receipt-signing key's fingerprint (§6) — a key distinct from any provider API key and from the LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11 publisher signing key. Required exactly when label=SELF_SIGNED_RECEIPT.

claimText.const: The same signing key produced this receipt and any other receipts under it (pseudonymous continuity only). This does NOT prove a genuine Fonebrew runtime, a specific device, or an unmodified app produced it, and does NOT prove the loop is safe, correct, representative, or suitable for another user.
This receipt is unsigned: no local signing key was available. No continuity claim can be made at all.
